Identity and homelands

Menominee origin traditions begin at the Menominee River, near the Nation’s present reservation in Wisconsin.

Read the sources [1] Menominee Indian Tribe of Wisconsin

02

Historical context

Treaties reduced the land base; federal termination in the 1950s was reversed through grassroots organizing and the Menominee Restoration Act of 1973.

Read the sources [1] Menominee Indian Tribe of Wisconsin

03

Living communities and further study

The Nation’s cultural museum and public history connect sovereignty and the homeland with language, culture, and contemporary community life.
